title: Four interactions, 38 orders of magnitude
caption: Relative strength at about 1 fm, with the strong interaction as 1: electromagnetism about 1/137 (0.0073), the weak interaction about 10⁻⁶ and gravity about 10⁻³⁸. The strongest and weakest differ by 38 orders of magnitude.
alt: A logarithmic scale of relative strength from 10 to the minus 40 up to 1, with gravity near 10 to the minus 38, the weak interaction at 10 to the minus 6, electromagnetism at 1 over 137 and the strong interaction at 1.
description: Gravity: about 10⁻³⁸ (infinite range): 38 orders below the strong interaction.
